## Fabrication tools

- [Fabrication Plate Builder](tools/plate-builder/index.qmd) creates plates, rings, and repeated holder holes.
- [Laser-Cut Leg & Support Builder](tools/leg-builder/index.qmd) creates legs, stands, triangular supports, and the wide single easel back.
- [Tool Organizer Gallery](tools/tool-organizer-gallery/index.qmd) shows organizer examples, construction ideas, drawings, and downloads.
- [Laser-Cutting Files and Resources](../teaching-materials/laser-cutting/index.qmd) collects downloadable files and classroom resources.
